scope.selection: All base spawnlist_npc centres inclusively within Classic region145; count0 and repeated placements preserved. Adjacent harbor merchant70022/spawn60994 explicitly included for travel. No modern-fork availability adopted.

official_comparison.result: Repeated four searches with the actual site:lineageclassic.plaync.com operator. Only a free-board community post surfaced, with no usable NPC-specific official dictionary/shop list. This bounded result does not establish official-source absence.

excluded_result.reason: NCER explicitly marks AI-generated information and requests official verification; not adopted as confirmed evidence

official_comparison.limit: Official item details confirm names/dock descriptions only; no NPC inventory/prices in collected item fields. NPC identity, placement, assortment, amount and fees remain L1J reference/LOCAL policy candidates.

excluded_community_result.reason: User community free-board result, not official NPC/shop documentation

price_rules.purchasing_price: NPC buys from player; -1 means unavailable; 0 is retained as valid zero
price_rules.pack_count: 0 normalized to1 by L1J ShopTable.java:83; selling_price is per pack, delivered amount=order_count*effective_pack_count (L1ShopBuyOrderList.java:55-100)
price_rules.tax_and_rate: LOCAL backend policy: preserved raw L1J DB prices x1 for sale/purchase and tax0; not official Classic economics
price_rules.order_id: L1J display-order input only; repeated within NPC, not classic wire row key or live item UID
price_rules.currency: L1J Adena40308 candidate classic7/$4; no wallet or funding created
price_rules.local_policy: Adopted x1/tax0 only; source prices/pack counts unchanged.
